character.description: Approved Bongbong three-quarter-right idle character; refine the existing eight-frame walk gait without redesigning the character.

walk.action: Eight distinct poses in an in-place rightward walk. Frames 1-4 show right-leg contact, loading, passing, push-off; frames 5-8 show the opposite left-leg contact, loading, passing, push-off. Opposite anatomical shoes must visibly lead in frames 1 and 5, with counter-swinging arms, a stable ground line and continuous loop. Do not redraw the head or enlarge the character.

style: Edit the accepted eight-frame Walk while retaining the approved three-quarter-right idle identity exactly. Keep head, face, hair, glasses, shirt, necklace, pixel palette and body size constant. Improve alternating planted feet and opposite arm swing.
